Chapter 509 - 509 Treat; My Mom Is Here! (1)

509 Treat; My Mom Is Here! (1)

The setting sun dyed the sky red, bright and beautiful.

As it was time to get off work, everyone was rushing home. The traffic was very congested.

Lin Fan raised his head. A tall building appeared before his eyes.

It was Jiangbei Hotel.

When Lin Fan saw this building, he could not help but think of the first time he came here. It was Old Master Qin Weiming who treated him to a meal.

Then, he thought of the unique delicacies in Jiangbei Hotel.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s stomach started to growl.

He looked at the black mass of cars in front of him, then turned the steering wheel and drove toward Jiangbei Hotel.

He had just parked his car when a thin figure in a white T-shirt happened to walk past him.

Lin Fan could not help but exclaim, “Cousin?!”

The man slowly turned around.

When he saw Lin Fan, he could not help but shout, “Lin Fan?”

Lin Fan did not get the wrong person.

This was his cousin, Lin Zihao.

Lin Fan said, “Cousin, when did you come to Jiangbei?”

“I came this year,” Lin Zihao said.

“Have you eaten? Let’s have a meal together,” Lin Fan said.

Lin Zihao’s stomach growled.

“Sure.” He nodded.

Thus, the two of them walked side by side, chatting as they walked into the Jiangbei Hotel.

…

At this moment, a large group of men and women in suits and leather shoes had already arrived at the Jiangbei Hotel.

The person in the lead was the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City, Zhang Zhou.

The people standing beside and behind Zhang Zhou all nodded and bowed, smiling obsequiously.

“I heard that the Jiangbei Hotel just airlifted a batch of sea urchins, tuna, abalones, and king crabs this morning…”

“I also heard that a wild boar was shipped in yesterday…”

“Head Chef Liu Wentao used to be a chef at a state banquet. I’ve already told him to cook today’s food.”

“Chairman Zhang, you came at the right time today!”

…

Zhang Zhou nodded arrogantly in response to the crowd’s praise.

When Zhang Zhou turned his head, he suddenly froze.

He saw a tall and handsome figure.

It was Lin Fan!

Zhang Zhou took a few quick steps and arrived in front of Lin Fan.

Then, he bowed and said in an extremely respectful and excited tone, “Mr. Lin, I didn’t expect to meet you here. What a coincidence.”

One had to know…

Lin Fan owned 51% of the shares of Xiao Wu Wholesale City. He could be said to be his boss.

In addition, the reason why Xiao Wu Wholesale City had been able to develop so much was all thanks to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan had made Xiao Wu Wholesale City the biggest agent for Flower Stem.

Flower Stem’s perfume and skincare products were a huge success.

It could be said that becoming a major agent of Flower Stem was equivalent to owning a banknote printing factory.

Every day, countless people offered money to work with Zhang Zhou.

Lin Fan finally noticed Zhang Zhou and said, “Yeah, what a coincidence.”

“I’ve been wanting to treat you to a meal for a long time. I just happened to meet you today. I wonder if you’re free today?”

Lin Fan did not reply. He turned to Lin Zihao and said, “Cousin, do you want to eat with them?”

“The more the merrier,” Lin Zihao said.

He could tell that Zhang Zhou and the people behind him all had extraordinary auras.

Even though Lin Zihao knew that Lin Fan seemed to be quite extraordinary now, he did not want Lin Fan to offend anyone over a meal.

Moreover, just as he said, the more the merrier.

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, let’s eat together.”

“That’s great!” Zhang Zhou said excitedly. “Mr. Lin and his cousin, this way, please.”

As he spoke, he bent down again and extended his right hand.

That appearance… He was like the most respectful waiter.

This scene shocked the men and women in suits standing behind him.

One had to know…

Zhang Zhou was the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City!

Even if they did not cooperate with Flower Stem, Xiao Wu Wholesale City was still a large company with a market value of more than ten billion.

After working with Flower Stem, their scale and reputation continued to rise.

In the end, Zhang Zhou actually treated a young man who looked to be in his 20s… so respectfully!

What was the identity of this young man?

Lin Zihao scratched the back of his head and said awkwardly, “This… Mr. Zhang, my name is Lin Zihao. You can just call me by my name.”

After all, Zhang Zhou was about 40 to 50 years old.

Zhang Zhou also felt that Lin Zihao was uncomfortable. He did not insist any longer and said, “Alright.”

To everyone’s surprise, Zhang Zhou personally led the two to the private room.

Lin Fan and Lin Zihao arrived at the luxurious Room No. 8.

Zhang Zhou personally pulled out a chair and arranged Lin Fan to sit in the first seat. Lin Zihao sat on Lin Fan’s left and he sat on his right.

“I heard that the Jiangbei Hotel just airlifted a batch of sea urchins, tuna, abalones, king crabs, and other seafood this morning,” Zhang Zhou said. “In addition, a wild boar arrived yesterday…

“Yes! Head Chef Liu Wentao is here. He used to be a chef at a state banquet. I’ve already made an agreement with him. He’ll personally cook today’s delicacies. The taste will definitely be good!”
